question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

Earlier I was __very poors__ in these subjects.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the word "poors."
 
• The word "poors" is not grammatically correct; the correct form is "poor."
 
• The correct sentence should be "Earlier I was very poor in these subjects."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Earlier I was very poor in these subjects."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "few poorer" ** – This option is grammatically incorrect as it does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **2: "very pored" ** – This option is grammatically incorrect and changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **4: "No improvement" ** – This option is incorrect because the original sentence has a grammatical error.
